papers.title: WeightCode: Installing New Capabilities into Neural Networks via Weight-Space Programming
papers.brief: WeightCode让冻结语言模型结合任务知识与现有权重，编写直接读取、构造或修改权重的程序。新增计算安装后独立运行，无需梯度训练或继续调用语言模型。
papers.tldr: 冻结语言模型生成可执行权重程序，无需梯度训练即可为神经网络安装新能力。
papers.what_it_is: WeightCode让冻结语言模型结合任务知识与现有权重，编写直接读取、构造或修改权重的程序。新增计算安装后独立运行，无需梯度训练或继续调用语言模型。
key_points: 语法或8个示例驱动安装，组合指令精确匹配达99.8%
ImageNet上4个权重程序净增8.84—17.62点
跨5个独立训练ViT复用，平均保留原增益83%—110%
papers.why_notable: 它将能力扩展从梯度训练转向可复用的权重程序，并展示保留原能力、跨网络迁移及叠加新能力的潜力。
papers.abstract: Neural networks encode learned capabilities in their weights, yet extending those capabilities with explicit task knowledge remains a fundamental challenge. Here we show that Weight-Space Programming (WSP), in which executable programs read, construct or modify a network's weights directly, can install new capabilities within trained neural networks. WeightCode, a WSP framework, uses a frozen language model to write executable weight programs that install new computations into trained neural networks using task knowledge and their existing weights, without gradient-based training. Once installed, the new capabilities run independently of the language model. Given a grammar or eight demonstrations, weight programs enable previously unseen command compositions (0% to 99.8% exact match) and a new pickup action (0% to 98.4% success), while preserving the original command and navigation capabilities. On ImageNet, four weight programs achieve net gains of 8.84-17.62 points while preserving clean accuracy, outperforming the best of eight fine-tuning methods under matched examples, checks, and retention constraints. In a Vision Transformer, causal interventions show that installed noise-correction gates drive robustness gains, while their selective activation preserves clean accuracy. Rerun on five independently trained Vision Transformers without further language model calls, ten weight programs retain 83-110% of their source-network gains on average, whereas copying their fixed weight edits yields negligible gains. Six programs written for an already edited network add 5.23-14.50 points of contrast robustness while retaining the previously installed noise gain. Together, these results establish WSP as a new route to acquiring and accumulating capabilities in trained neural networks through reusable weight programs.

papers.title: AgentRoboCritic: Understanding the Capability of Frontier Agents on Direct Robot Control
papers.brief: 提出意图驱动的动作评析框架，让策略智能体为每步动作声明局部意图，再由评估器对照实际结果判断成败与失误类型，并用于分析十二项操作基准。
papers.tldr: 通过意图对照逐动作评估，揭示前沿智能体直接控机器人的能力与执行瓶颈。
papers.what_it_is: 提出意图驱动的动作评析框架，让策略智能体为每步动作声明局部意图，再由评估器对照实际结果判断成败与失误类型，并用于分析十二项操作基准。
key_points: 覆盖12项操作基准，发现抓取、对齐及恢复瓶颈
以400个人工标注动作验证评估器，发布12,844条标注
Muse-Glimmer-30B失误分类准确率从32.58%升至74.24%
papers.why_notable: 将整回合成功率细化为可定位的动作级诊断，区分语义理解与物理执行问题；开源评估器和标注数据降低了后续分析成本。
papers.abstract: Frontier multimodal language agents such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated strong capabilities in controlling robots directly via low-level numerical actions without high-level primitives. However, existing benchmarks report only episode-level success rates, which show neither how these agents succeed nor where they fail. In this paper, we present a systematic action-level analysis of frontier agents on direct robot control across 12 manipulation benchmarks. We introduce AgentRoboCritic, an intent-grounded critique framework in which the policy agent states a local intent alongside each action, and a critic evaluates the action's outcome and failure mode against this intent. Our action-level analysis demonstrates the promising capabilities of frontier agents on direct robot control, including closed-loop recovery from local execution failures, reliable semantic grounding across diverse scenes, and strong zero-shot manipulation without task-specific adaptation. It also identifies their current limitations, including task-relevant physical execution bottlenecks such as grasping and alignment, and uneven recovery across failure modes. Finally, we validate our critic on a 400-action human-annotated benchmark and release a dataset of 12,844 annotated actions alongside a fine-tuned open-source critic, Muse-Glimmer-30B, whose failure-mode accuracy rises from 32.58% to 74.24%, enabling low-cost action-level analysis.
papers.organization: Chenyan Xiong Research Group at CMU

papers.title: GameWM: Toward Next-Generation Video Games with Interaction-Centric World Models
papers.brief: GameWM将规则、状态、相机和布局交给游戏引擎，把视觉与交互细节交给视频模型。系统结合交互数据引擎、创作素材接口及实时因果模型，支持个性化游戏体验。
papers.tldr: 通过游戏引擎与视频模型分工，在精确规则下生成多样化世界与交互细节。
papers.what_it_is: GameWM将规则、状态、相机和布局交给游戏引擎，把视觉与交互细节交给视频模型。系统结合交互数据引擎、创作素材接口及实时因果模型，支持个性化游戏体验。
key_points: 引擎固定事件时序与结果，视频模型生成交互细节
以交互为中心构建数据，接入角色、场景与技能素材
模型规模覆盖5B至33B，包含实时因果变体
papers.why_notable: 让视频模型不再只为引擎画面换皮，而能丰富同一机制的表现形式，有望兼顾游戏结果的确定性与个性化内容生成。
papers.abstract: For more than half a century, video games have pursued better graphics, more natural interaction, and more engaging gameplay. Generative video models (VMs) now bear on all three. Neural networks already draw most of the pixels in shipped games, and recent world models let a lightweight game engine keep the world state while a VM turns the engine's coarse proxy video into final frames. These systems, however, treat the VM as a renderer that only restyles motion the engine has already authored, which leaves most of its generative capacity unused and limits the diversity a game can offer. We present GameWM, a design for next-generation games built on a clear division of labor. The GameWM-engine keeps what must be exact: rules, state, camera, and the layout of the world, which also spares the video model from having to remember it. The GameWM-VM generates what is expensive to author by hand: the look of the world and the detail of the player's interactions. One game mechanic can then be realized in many visually and physically distinct ways, while its outcome stays exactly as the engine computed it. To realize this division of labor, we build GameWM as a complete system: a data engine centered on interactions rather than exploration, an interface through which authored character sheets, scene art, and skill descriptions enter the model, and a model family from 5B to 33B parameters with a real-time causal variant for play. Together they give every player a fresh version of the same game: each player's own character, world, and skills turn the same engine mechanics into a new experience, while every event keeps the timing and outcome the GameWM-engine computed.

papers.title: Self-WSP: Can Language Models Improve Themselves Through Weight-Space Programming?
papers.brief: 研究让Qwen3.5-0.8B读取并修改自身权重，再以修改后的模型继续解题和编辑，探索Self-WSP能否实现持续自我改进。
papers.tldr: 小型语言模型可通过编辑自身权重提升数学能力，但收益未必源于理解。
papers.what_it_is: 研究让Qwen3.5-0.8B读取并修改自身权重，再以修改后的模型继续解题和编辑，探索Self-WSP能否实现持续自我改进。
key_points: GSM8K准确率从11.8%升至62.2%
MATH500准确率从7.0%升至32.2%
部分自编辑仅改16个参数，随机搜索有时效果相当
papers.why_notable: 它展示了直接改写权重实现自我提升的潜力，但模型对修改缺乏理解，说明能力增益不能直接视为递归自我改进能力。
papers.abstract: Frontier language models can now read and edit the weights of a neural network much like code and thereby improve a small model, an approach known as Weight-Space Programming (WSP). We further explore applying WSP to a language model itself, which we call Self-WSP. Specifically, Qwen3.5-0.8B reads its own weights, proposes an edit, and then continues with the edited weights as both problem solver and editor. We find many cases of genuine self-improvement. Self-edits can raise GSM8K accuracy from 11.8% to 62.2% and MATH500 accuracy from 7.0% to 32.2%, sometimes by changing only 16 parameters, and in some cases repeated self-editing keeps improving the model. A closer look, however, reveals that these gains lack interpretability. The model shows little understanding of the edits it makes, and WSP driven by random search sometimes performs comparably. Self-WSP thus holds promise as a path toward recursive self-improvement (RSI), but realizing this promise requires further exploration.

papers.title: Autoregressive View Model
papers.brief: AVM以图像或视频为条件，沿指定相机路径生成短片，并检索输入及生成历史中的相关视图。模型通过流匹配微调视频扩散模型，再用自身生成轨迹训练因果模型。
papers.tldr: 无需显式三维表示，以自回归视图生成统一处理场景重建与新视角外推。
papers.what_it_is: AVM以图像或视频为条件，沿指定相机路径生成短片，并检索输入及生成历史中的相关视图。模型通过流匹配微调视频扩散模型，再用自身生成轨迹训练因果模型。
key_points: 采用N输入、1输出的流匹配训练方案
检索相关视图，维持有界活跃上下文
训练规模约800万场景与视频片段
papers.why_notable: 将重建、插值和未见区域外推纳入同一接口，绕开显式三维建模；自身生成轨迹训练有助于减少去噪步数与长期漂移。
papers.abstract: We present the Autoregressive View Model (AVM), which generates a scene as a stream of views without constructing an explicit 3D representation. Through a unified in-context interface, AVM conditions on images or videos to generate short clips along a requested camera path. Visual context grounds reconstruction and interpolation, while a learned prior enables extrapolation into unseen regions. AVM retrieves relevant views from inputs and generated history to form a bounded active context. We fine-tune a pretrained bidirectional video diffusion transformer with flow matching in an N-in-1-out formulation. We then tune a causal model on its own rollouts to improve photorealism, reduce denoising steps, and limit long-horizon drift. We scale training to approximately 8M scenes and video clips. We evaluate generation capacity and scene persistence across benchmarks for camera control, text control, visual quality, dynamics, sparse and 4D reconstruction, and long-horizon consistency. The results demonstrate that AVM adapts to diverse input and output settings through one in-context interface.

papers.title: PURE: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Multi-Granularity Multimodal Identity Matching
papers.brief: PURE将电商记录的身份匹配拆为感知、理解、推理和证据支撑判断四维能力，区分基础与变体粒度，以专家核验的多选题定位模型失误。
papers.tldr: 用电商多粒度身份匹配诊断多模态模型，揭示证据判断与变体识别短板。
papers.what_it_is: PURE将电商记录的身份匹配拆为感知、理解、推理和证据支撑判断四维能力，区分基础与变体粒度，以专家核验的多选题定位模型失误。
key_points: 含1457道多选题、14项任务，由两位领域专家核验
评测10个多模态大模型，总分47.1%至86.0%
模态消融显示多模态证据有益，但模型会误判匹配记录存在冲突
papers.why_notable: 它将总体匹配准确率拆成可定位的能力缺口，揭示视觉差异定位和变体规则判断弱点，为模型改进提供更具体的评测依据。
papers.abstract: Identity matching asks whether two records denote the same identity, yet the answer depends on the target granularity. Two records may match at the base level but not at the variant level: they share an underlying design while differing in attributes such as color or size. Final matching accuracy does not separately characterize the capabilities involved. To study this problem, we use e-commerce as a challenging real-world domain. We introduce PURE, a diagnostic benchmark for multi-granularity multimodal identity matching covering four capability dimensions: Perception, Understanding, Reasoning, and Evidence-grounded Judgment. The benchmark comprises 1,457 multiple-choice questions across 14 tasks, derived from real-world matching pairs and verified by two domain experts. Across ten recent MLLMs, overall scores range from 47.1% to 86.0%. Understanding receives the highest mean score and Judgment the lowest, with weaknesses in visual difference localization and variant-level rule judgment. Modality ablations show that models benefit from multimodal evidence but can incorrectly identify conflicts between matching records. In direct matching, most models recognize matching pairs more reliably than non-matching pairs at the base level, whereas the reverse holds at the variant level. PURE therefore reveals what aggregate matching accuracy hides: not only whether models judge a pair correctly, but where they struggle to interpret evidence and apply matching criteria.

papers.title: Moving Generality from Model to Modeler: LLM Agents for PHM on a Deployment-Style Benchmark
papers.brief: 研究构建面向未见设备的部署式基准，让大模型编码智能体限时交付预测器。通过交换设计方案、比较执行能力，分析优势来自数据驱动的设计还是代码实现。
papers.tldr: 设备健康预测实验表明，通用能力可能来自按任务设计模型的智能体，而非固定模型。
papers.what_it_is: 研究构建面向未见设备的部署式基准，让大模型编码智能体限时交付预测器。通过交换设计方案、比较执行能力，分析优势来自数据驱动的设计还是代码实现。
key_points: NextUnit-Bench含24个数据集、58折，限时2小时
AutoML得分不足最强智能体一半；30个论文实现仅6个胜出
数百字方案传递多数性能差距，开放权重模型交付率减半
papers.why_notable: 将泛化能力的评估对象从固定模型转向建模智能体，并区分数据驱动设计与执行能力，为自动建模的部署评测提供新视角。
papers.abstract: Coding agents built on large language models (LLMs) now help develop many models published as general solutions. Should generality instead reside in the agent that builds a model for each new task? We examine this question in prognostics and health management (PHM), where every model must work on unseen equipment. Our deployment-style benchmark, NextUnit-Bench, covers 24 public datasets split into 58 folds that hold out units or operating conditions; each agent has two hours to deliver an executable predictor, then run on the hidden units. First, frontier agents outperform AutoML, which reaches less than half the best agent's score, and faithful implementations of published methods on four datasets, of which only 6 of 30 beat the strongest agent's own design; published accuracies, where reproducible, rest on the papers' own conventions, and a single convention, capping the remaining life of test engines, can halve the reported error. Second, the agents' advantage is a design made on each machine's data; once made, a plain-text plan of a few hundred words carries most of the gap between two frontier agents, and given a weaker agent's plan, the strongest agent falls to that agent's level, often to identical predictions. Before touching the data, however, it matters little whose plan an agent carries out, and domain toolkits appear to help neither: what sets the strongest apart is how much it learns from the data. Third, such designs reach only implementers that can execute them: given the strongest agent's designs, a locally deployable open-weight model delivers half as often, even when they are lightened, and scores no higher than without them. Generality, we argue, is not disappearing but moving, from the model to the modeler.

papers.title: GameAnything: From Any Inspirations to Playable Game Worlds
papers.brief: GameAnything是开源智能体平台，面向现有游戏生成可玩扩展。它结合编码智能体、独立试玩评审、持久开发状态与经验记忆，持续修改并检验游戏体验。
papers.tldr: 用编码智能体与独立试玩评审，将多模态灵感迭代转化为可玩的游戏扩展。
papers.what_it_is: GameAnything是开源智能体平台，面向现有游戏生成可玩扩展。它结合编码智能体、独立试玩评审、持久开发状态与经验记忆，持续修改并检验游戏体验。
key_points: GameAnything-Bench覆盖多模态参考与多种游戏环境
评测9种编码智能体配置，交互与精确修改仍是难点
多模态参考提升内容忠实度，迭代收益因智能体而异
papers.why_notable: 把评测重点从代码是否完成推进到游戏能否真正游玩、体验是否合格，为灵感驱动的游戏开发提供更贴近实际的测试框架。
papers.abstract: AI-driven game development holds the potential to transform diverse human inspirations into interactive experiences. However, existing systems and benchmarks primarily focus on explicit development specifications, with limited support for adapting multimodal references and evaluating actual gameplay experiences. We introduce GameAnything, an open-source agentic platform that transforms multimodal inspirations into playable extensions of existing games through iterative development. GameAnything integrates coding agents with an independent playtesting critic, persistent development state, and reusable experience memory to support continuous refinement. We further present GameAnything-Bench, a benchmark spanning diverse reference modalities, game creation objectives, and gaming environments, with exploratory gameplay testing to assess both functional correctness and gameplay quality. Evaluations of nine coding agent configurations reveal that current agents can adapt reference content but still struggle with playable interactions and precise modifications. Moreover, multimodal references improve content fidelity, while iterative refinement yields substantial but varying improvements across agents. These findings highlight both the potential and remaining challenges of inspiration-driven game development.

papers.title: Non-penetrating World Models
papers.brief: 提出轻量框架NoPeWorld，在冻结的扩散Transformer隐藏状态上训练小型预测头，判断候选动作是否安全，再用尽量保留原意的安全动作替换危险动作。
papers.tldr: 通过读取视频世界模型的隐藏状态并替换危险动作，大幅减少物体穿透障碍的错误。
papers.what_it_is: 提出轻量框架NoPeWorld，在冻结的扩散Transformer隐藏状态上训练小型预测头，判断候选动作是否安全，再用尽量保留原意的安全动作替换危险动作。
key_points: NoPeBench评测发现，现有开源模型均无法可靠防止穿透
冻结DiT，仅训练小型预测头识别动作穿透风险
六个视频世界模型的平均物理违规率从74%降至16%
papers.why_notable: 表明模型内部已有可用于预测物理违规的信息，无需重训主模型即可利用；还能零样本泛化到开放域图像、第三人称视角和移动障碍。
papers.abstract: We study a new problem of preventing object penetration in interactive video world models. To understand how existing models handle this, we introduce NoPeBench, a benchmark that evaluates how world models respond to physical obstacles. Our evaluation reveals that none of the open-source models can reliably prevent such failures. Surprisingly, however, these models already encode the information needed to predict such violations. We find that the hidden states of diffusion transformers (DiTs) can predict whether a candidate action will penetrate an obstacle. Building on this, we introduce NoPeWorld, a lightweight framework that detects and prevents penetration. Specifically, we train a small prediction head on top of a frozen DiT's hidden states to read out if a candidate action is safe or not. Unsafe actions are then replaced with safe ones that best preserve the original intent. Despite its simplicity, NoPeWorld substantially reduces the physical violation rate, averaged over six video world models, from 74% to 16%. Remarkably, our method shows zero-shot generalization to open-domain imagery, third-person viewpoints, and moving obstacles. We publicly release our code, the NoPeBench benchmark, and model weights. Project Page: https://nopeworld.github.io .

papers.title: Learning Video Foresight Reasoning from Unlabeled Videos via On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.brief: Future-OPSD利用过去与未来视频配对，开展同策略自蒸馏，无需额外标注或外部大模型监督。结合对比优势与师生蒸馏，突出决策相关信息。
papers.tldr: 通过无标注视频自蒸馏学习关键未来信息，提升视觉语言模型的预测与规划能力。
papers.what_it_is: Future-OPSD利用过去与未来视频配对，开展同策略自蒸馏，无需额外标注或外部大模型监督。结合对比优势与师生蒸馏，突出决策相关信息。
key_points: 过去—未来视频对提供自然自监督信号
前瞻分数下界融合对比特权优势与蒸馏优势
开放预测与封闭规划最高提升14.2、15.9点
papers.why_notable: 将视频自身的时间结构转化为监督，并区分关键未来信息与无关背景，为可扩展的预测学习提供路径，且未损害通用视频理解。
papers.abstract: Video foresight reasoning requires vision-language models to anticipate future events or next actions from currently observed videos. Existing methods fit future captions, rationales, or full visual states, but face two limitations. First, they rely on annotations or external large models for supervision, limiting scalability. We address this with an on-policy self-distillation framework that turns past-future video pairs into a natural self-supervised signal without extra annotations or LLM supervision. Second, they treat the whole future clip as equally valuable, although most of it is irrelevant context information. We address this by defining a foresight score, from which we obtain a contrastive privilege advantage that drives the model to learn the most valuable future information. Since the score is intractable, we optimize a tractable lower-bound surrogate that interpolates this advantage, computed between the true and a random reference future, with a teacher-student distillation advantage; together, they amplify decision-relevant content information and suppress irrelevant context information. We call the resulting framework Future-OPSD. On open-ended prediction and closed-ended planning, Future-OPSD improves base models by up to 14.2 and 15.9 points without compromising general video understanding. Code will be available at https://jingchensun.github.io/future-opsd/

papers.title: Duopra: From Full-Duplex Conversation to Full-Duplex Agency
papers.brief: 提出兼顾对话控制与任务执行的全双工模型，将后端视为接收完整自然语言请求的工具，并通过三阶段训练统一直接调用与后端委派。
papers.tldr: Duopra将全双工对话与任务执行联合训练，显著提升工具调用成功率。
papers.what_it_is: 提出兼顾对话控制与任务执行的全双工模型，将后端视为接收完整自然语言请求的工具，并通过三阶段训练统一直接调用与后端委派。
key_points: 三阶段：协议SFT、全双工RL、投影层修复
FDB v3同后端Pass@1从4.7%升至44.7%
直接调用成功率47.7%，DeepSeek后端49.3%
papers.why_notable: 将优化重点前移到请求发起与参数完整性，而非仅依赖后端执行能力；结果显示，任务执行能力可与低延迟对话控制共存。
papers.abstract: Full-duplex interaction models exhibit strong conversational agency, enabling natural, low-latency turn-taking, backchannels, and interruptions. However, completing tasks further requires task agency: timely tool invocation and argument revision following user corrections. Frontend-backend agents separate initiation from execution: the frontend decides whether and what to request, while the backend determines how. Execution can be offloaded, but unsent requests cannot be executed, and incomplete ones can misdirect the backend. On Full-Duplex-Bench v3 (FDB v3), most failures of Realtime-Venus-Audio + Harness in our streaming pipeline occur before a domain tool executes. We introduce Duopra, a full-duplex interaction model that learns task execution alongside conversational control. Duopra treats the backend as a tool, accepting a self-contained natural-language request. Direct calls and backend delegation share an action interface and requirements for faithful initiation and correct execution. Its three-stage training combines protocol SFT, full-duplex RL rewarding timely and complete execution, and projector-only repair of talker conditioning after thinker updates. With the same backend, Pass@1 rises from 4.7% to 44.7%; Duopra achieves 47.7% calling tools directly (26.0% after SFT) and 49.3% with a DeepSeek backend. It improves three FDB v1.0 takeover rates over the base model. These results show that task agency can coexist with key conversational agency.

papers.title: MemOnce: A Scalable Memory Architecture for Large Language Models
papers.brief: MemOnce是一种可扩展语言模型记忆架构，仅缓存少量末层隐状态，再动态解码为各注意力层的KV缓存，并按当前输入检索相关记忆。
papers.tldr: 通过压缩记忆与跨层共享稀疏检索，大幅降低长上下文推理开销。
papers.what_it_is: MemOnce是一种可扩展语言模型记忆架构，仅缓存少量末层隐状态，再动态解码为各注意力层的KV缓存，并按当前输入检索相关记忆。
key_points: 记忆编码器—解码器将末层隐状态还原为KV缓存
记忆稀疏注意力跨层复用检索索引，实现线性计算
Qwen3.5-4B百万上下文缓存缩减1313倍
papers.why_notable: 它为长期交互提供了兼顾细节保留与低开销的记忆方案；百万上下文预填充延迟降低6.9倍，记忆表现也有所提升。
papers.abstract: Deploying large language models (LLMs) in long-horizon and continual interactions requires maintaining reusable memory states for future inference, posing challenges for existing architectures. Standard Transformers accumulate layer-wise, token-level KV caches, incurring linear GPU memory growth and quadratic computational complexity as the context expands. In contrast, linear-time architectures compress history into fixed-size states, but struggle to retain fine-grained details. We introduce MemOnce, a foundation architecture that learns scalable memory states for language models. MemOnce is based on two core designs: (a) Memory encoder-decoder: it caches only a small subset of final-layer hidden states as compact memory representations and dynamically decodes them back into KV caches for attention layers; (b) Memory sparse attention: for each continual input, MemOnce adaptively retrieves relevant memory representations, with the sparse indices computed only once across layers. Coupling these two designs enables efficient on-the-fly memory loading and KV cache decoding, drastically reducing the GPU memory footprint and achieving linear-time complexity. We conduct extensive experiments to show that MemOnce outperforms Transformers and other architectures across varying model sizes, context lengths, and training paradigms (pretraining and post-training adaptation). In particular, adapting Qwen3.5-4B with MemOnce reduces memory state cache by 1313$\times$ and prefill latency by 6.9$\times$ at 1M context, and improves throughput by 3.5$\times$ and overall memory performance by +5.77%. Finally, MemOnce generalizes zero-shot to downstream representation tasks, achieving competitive results against specialized models.

papers.title: Plan4D: Generative Plannable 4D Worlds
papers.brief: 从场景上下文和文本动作出发，同时生成未来视频与稠密四维几何。通过拼接视频生成器和三维重建器，并增加场景流预测头，支持长时程、细粒度动作规划。
papers.tldr: 融合视频生成与三维重建先验，同步预测动作驱动的未来视频与四维几何。
papers.what_it_is: 从场景上下文和文本动作出发，同时生成未来视频与稠密四维几何。通过拼接视频生成器和三维重建器，并增加场景流预测头，支持长时程、细粒度动作规划。
key_points: 拼接Depth Anything 3与LongCat-Video
辅助DPT头预测场景流，补充动态几何
在合成与真实数据上验证，四维生成达到最优水平
papers.why_notable: 将未来预测从视觉逼真推进到时序几何一致，利用互补模型先验缓解动作与四维标注稀缺，为动态场景规划提供更丰富的状态表示。
papers.abstract: Most world models for future prediction prioritize aestetic quality of generated videos, but offer only weak physical grounding and limited geometric consistency over time, due to the lack of explicit 4D modeling. In this paper, we introduce plan4d, a possible next milestone towards building a generative plannable 4D world model that predicts future RGB videos together with dense 4D geometry, including depth, cameras, point clouds, and scene flow from an observed scene context and text-specified actions. Since training data with paired actions and dense 4D annotations is inherently scarce, plan4d leverages the complementary priors of foundational video generators and 3D reconstructors. Specifically, we propose a model-stitching architecture that couples Depth Anything 3 with LongCat-Video and augments it with an auxiliary DPT head for scene-flow prediction. The resulting model allows us to plan and generate complex, long-horizon, and fine-grained actions in a dynamic 3D scenes, while substantially improving both visual fidelity and geometric accuracy of the generated future videos. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that plan4d achieves state-of-the-art performance in generative 4D modeling of environmental reactions. Project Page: https://fogradio.github.io/plan4d-project

papers.title: cmHC: Balancing Stream Mixing in Hyper-Connections via Geometric Contraction
papers.brief: 提出cmHC，将双随机残差混合矩阵的可行域向内部几何收缩，无需新增参数化。通过浅层适度收缩，平衡混合不足与过度混合。
papers.tldr: 通过几何收缩平衡多流残差混合，兼顾流间区分度与大模型训练稳定性。
papers.what_it_is: 提出cmHC，将双随机残差混合矩阵的可行域向内部几何收缩，无需新增参数化。通过浅层适度收缩，平衡混合不足与过度混合。
key_points: 理论约束跨层累计混合、流差异与混合系数梯度差异
cmHC保持精确双随机性，提供可证明的流混合界
Ascend NPU融合算子使超连接延迟最多降低44.8%
papers.why_notable: 把多流残差的混合强度转化为可控几何约束，并在多种规模的稠密与混合专家模型上验证，兼顾训练稳定性与执行效率。
papers.abstract: Manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) extends residual connections to multiple streams and stabilizes residual propagation by constraining stream-mixing residual matrices to the Birkhoff polytope, the set of doubly stochastic matrices. In this work, we investigate how to effectively mix residual streams within the Birkhoff polytope. We reveal a mixing trade-off: when under-mixed residual matrices stay close to the vertices of the Birkhoff polytope, hyper-connections will degenerate into a set of nearly independent streams; when over-mixed residual matrices are concentrated around the uniform barycenter of the polytope, streams will become less distinguishable from each other. We theoretically validate our findings by bounding the cumulative residual mixing, stream difference and gradient difference of mixing coefficients across layers. Motivated by these findings, we propose Contraction for Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (cmHC), an exact doubly stochastic method which geometrically contracts the Birkhoff polytope toward its interior. This contraction mitigates under-mixing by forcing the residual matrices to explore deeper into the polytope, with a provable stream mixing bound and no new parameterization. Moreover, we apply a moderate contraction at the shallow layers to prevent over-mixing, enabling stable gradient propagation on extremely large-scale model pretraining. Extensive experiments across dense and mixture-of-experts models at various parameter scales demonstrate the effectiveness and scalability of cmHC. We also develop fused operators for cmHC on Ascend NPUs, reducing hyper-connection execution latency by up to 44.8%.

papers.title: Reading the Unreadable: Text-Aware Image Super-Resolution Needs Reasoning
papers.brief: 研究构建基准与识别指标，检验文字恢复是否需要推理；提出免训练插件RTC，用外部多模态模型推断退化文字，再以描述引导文本条件超分模型。
papers.tldr: 借助多模态模型推理退化文字，再引导超分辨率，改善难辨文本的恢复。
papers.what_it_is: 研究构建基准与识别指标，检验文字恢复是否需要推理；提出免训练插件RTC，用外部多模态模型推断退化文字，再以描述引导文本条件超分模型。
key_points: ReasonText区分需推理文本与可局部恢复文本
GTTCA排除检测误差，评测12个超分模型
免训练RTC改善全部6个受测文本条件模型
papers.why_notable: 它揭示文字超分模型在推理型文本上的系统性短板，并证明外接推理能力可改善恢复，为超分模型设计提供新方向。
papers.abstract: Text-aware image super-resolution (TAISR) aims to recover high-resolution images from low-resolution inputs while preserving textual content. Existing methods treat this as a visual restoration problem, yet severely degraded text often cannot be read from local visual evidence alone. Humans instead read it by reasoning over image context, logical patterns, and prior knowledge. This raises a fundamental question: Does TAISR need reasoning? To answer this, we introduce two diagnostic tools. The first, ReasonText, is a human-curated benchmark that separates reasoning-required text from locally recoverable text. The second, Ground-Truth Text-Crop Accuracy (GTTCA), is a recognition-based metric that measures text restoration quality without text detection errors. Evaluating twelve recent super-resolution (SR) models, we find a consistent and substantial performance drop on reasoning-required text, revealing a systematic blind spot. Two observations point to a remedy. One is that text-conditioned SR models restore text substantially better when given ground-truth text. The other is that multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can read degraded text in low-resolution images through reasoning. We therefore propose Reasoning Transfer via Captioning (RTC), a training-free plug-in that uses an external MLLM to infer the degraded text and feeds the resulting caption to a text-conditioned SR model. RTC consistently improves all six text-conditioned SR models we evaluate, especially on reasoning-required text. Surprisingly, a real-world SR model with RTC can even outperform the TAISR model with RTC, suggesting that reasoning should be a core design axis for future TAISR.

papers.title: AutoPILOT: A Visual Agent Harness for Real-Time Gameplay
papers.brief: AutoPILOT改造视觉智能体的动作执行框架，让模型单次调用可输出基础动作、开环宏或闭环控制器，后者持续根据屏幕行动，直到交还控制权。
papers.tldr: 通过持续执行宏动作与闭环控制器，让视觉智能体不必等待模型思考也能实时玩游戏。
papers.what_it_is: AutoPILOT改造视觉智能体的动作执行框架，让模型单次调用可输出基础动作、开环宏或闭环控制器，后者持续根据屏幕行动，直到交还控制权。
key_points: AFK-Bench含120款浏览器游戏，支持实时与暂停模式
同预算实时成功率68.6%，VISTA为38.3%
达到VISTA最终成功率仅需其五分之一API成本
papers.why_notable: 它将模型思考频率与动作执行频率解耦，表明执行框架本身能显著改善实时表现，为低成本、持续响应的视觉智能体提供设计方向。
papers.abstract: Multimodal foundation models can play video games well when the game waits for them, but often fail when it keeps running. We find that much of this gap lies in the harness, which decides what the model sees, what it remembers, and how its outputs become actions over time. Existing harnesses such as VISTA improve the first two, yet turn each model call into at most one action, so the agent acts only as often as its model thinks. We introduce AutoPILOT, which changes the third: in each model call, the model can send a primitive action, start an open-loop macro, or write a closed-loop controller that keeps playing from the screen without further model calls until it hands control back. To evaluate agents in real-time games, we build AFK-Bench, 120 diverse browser games grouped by how they respond to inaction and playable in real time or with the clock paused. With GPT-6.1 Sol under the same budgets, AutoPILOT reaches 68.6% real-time success against 38.3% for VISTA, and on GameWorld it keeps 80.0% in real time while VISTA drops from 84.1% to 42.9%. Its gains hold across models, and it reaches VISTA's final success rate at a fifth of its API cost. Our results suggest that how a harness turns model outputs into actions over time is a central yet underexplored part of agent design, and we hope AutoPILOT and AFK-Bench will serve as a foundation for agents in a world that does not wait.

papers.title: StereoVLM: Binocular Vision-Language Models for Metric 3D Spatial Reasoning
papers.brief: StereoVLM从标定双目图像学习三维表征，依次训练跨视图对应、视差估计、标定条件深度感知与语义空间推理，并构建三级评测基准。
papers.tldr: 通过标定双目几何与分层监督，让视觉语言模型获得可迁移的三维度量推理能力。
papers.what_it_is: StereoVLM从标定双目图像学习三维表征，依次训练跨视图对应、视差估计、标定条件深度感知与语义空间推理，并构建三级评测基准。
key_points: 视差监督在未见环境中比直接双目深度监督更易泛化
StereoVLM-8B深度准确率95.17%，物体级得分66.98
分层监督使五项空间基准平均提升3.54分
papers.why_notable: 干预实验表明收益来自有效跨视图几何，而非仅靠更多视觉词元或语义先验；RoboCasa操控成功率也提升4.3个百分点。
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong semantic understanding but remain limited in their ability to reason about metric 3D space in the physical world. Existing VLMs typically infer 3D scene structure from one or more images without known camera calibration or cross-view geometric constraints. This makes metric 3D inference inherently ambiguous and leaves it unclear whether their spatial predictions are grounded in visual evidence or driven primarily by semantic priors. In contrast, calibrated stereo provides explicit cross-view geometry that resolves this ambiguity and offers a more reliable foundation for metric 3D perception and geometric generalization. We investigate how VLMs can learn transferable 3D representations directly from calibrated binocular observations. To this end, we introduce StereoVLM, the first geometry-aware binocular VLM for metric 3D spatial reasoning. StereoVLM follows a hierarchical learning paradigm spanning from cross-view correspondence and disparity estimation to calibration-conditioned metric depth perception and semantic spatial reasoning. We further find that disparity supervision generalizes substantially better than direct binocular depth supervision on unseen environments. To evaluate these capabilities, we introduce Stereo3D-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark across three levels, from point-level geometry to object-level spatial reasoning. StereoVLM-8B achieves 95.17% depth accuracy ($δ_1$) and a 66.98 average object-level score on Stereo3D-Bench. Intervention results further indicate that the model's performance on Stereo3D-Bench benefits from valid cross-view geometry and cannot be explained solely by additional visual tokens or semantic priors. Hierarchical geometric supervision also yields average gains of 3.54 points across five spatial benchmarks and 4.3 percentage points in RoboCasa manipulation success.

papers.title: How Feedback-Free Self-Evolution Reshapes Agent Skills: A Systematic Study
papers.brief: 研究让模型在无任务、执行或评判反馈下反复改写专家技能，并测试智能体表现。通过对比模型自行生成的技能，定位被丢失的知识，再用SkillDiff原位标记。
papers.tldr: 无反馈重写会侵蚀智能体技能中的专家知识，标记模型盲区可提升表现。
papers.what_it_is: 研究让模型在无任务、执行或评判反馈下反复改写专家技能，并测试智能体表现。通过对比模型自行生成的技能，定位被丢失的知识，再用SkillDiff原位标记。
key_points: 重写30轮后，SkillsBench平均下降15分
重写趋向模型先验，优先丢失先验外知识
SkillDiff不改技能正文，平均提升4.8分
papers.why_notable: 揭示无反馈自我演化可能抹去专家知识，而非积累能力；以轻量标记保留模型不擅长生成的知识，为技能维护提供可操作方向。
papers.abstract: Agent skills are documents in which experts write down procedural knowledge, and models increasingly maintain them by rewriting them without feedback. Such rewriting could adapt a skill to the model that uses it or erode the expert knowledge that makes it useful, yet how skills evolve under this feedback-free self-evolution has not been studied. We let models rewrite expert skills round after round without any task, run or judgment and run agents built on the same models with the rewritten skills. Our experiments show that the skills lose value rather than improve, as every model we test performs worse with them on every benchmark, by 15 points on average on SkillsBench after thirty rounds. Sampling each model's prior with skills it writes from the topic alone, we find that rewriting pulls skills toward this prior and gives up first the knowledge outside it. Putting this knowledge back recovers much of the lost pass rate, so an expert's skill is valuable largely for what the model does not write on its own. Building on this insight, SkillDiff marks this knowledge in place and raises the pass rate on SkillsBench by 4.8 points on average without feedback or any change to the skill's text. Project repository: https://github.com/LitaoGuo/How-Self-Evolution-Reshapes-Skills.

papers.title: Seeing the Invisible: How Vision-Language Models Read, Predict and Trace Radio Fields
papers.brief: 构建无需人工标注的城市射线追踪引擎，生成无线电场推理数据集RadioVISTA。通过单因素反事实与精确答案，测试模型读场、预测和追踪传播路径的能力。
papers.tldr: 视觉语言模型能判断城市无线电场强，却难追踪传播路径，暴露物理推理短板。
papers.what_it_is: 构建无需人工标注的城市射线追踪引擎，生成无线电场推理数据集RadioVISTA。通过单因素反事实与精确答案，测试模型读场、预测和追踪传播路径的能力。
key_points: 覆盖六大洲，射线追踪生成精确答案与单因素反事实
前沿模型能判断场强，却难识别直达或单墙传播路径
9B模型微调后场强判断接近前沿，路径追踪仍无改善
papers.why_notable: 将场强判断与传播几何推理解耦，揭示答对结果不等于掌握物理机制，也指出仅监督最终答案的训练局限。
papers.abstract: Operating in the physical world requires reasoning beyond what cameras directly capture. In a city, radio signals are invisible to the lens, yet their strength is governed by the buildings and streets an image does show. Given only these visible structures, can vision-language models (VLMs) infer the invisible radio field they shape? Probing true physical reasoning requires exact fields in real cities, alongside controlled interventions where a single physical factor changes. We build a label-free engine that turns any coordinate on Earth into a ray-traceable city, simulates matched single-factor counterfactuals, and computes every answer exactly. This yields RadioVISTA, a benchmark and training dataset for visual reasoning about invisible fields. Physically, a radio field is the sum of its propagation paths, yet across six continents we uncover a striking field-path dissociation: frontier VLMs accurately judge where a field is strong, but fail to tell whether a single direct or one-wall path exists. Open models fail even earlier at reading the field itself, and are systematically wrong, scoring below random guessing even when credited for any of four attempts. On unseen cities, fine-tuning brings a 9B open model close to frontier proprietary models on fields, yet neither supervised nor reinforcement fine-tuning improves path tracing. Supervising only final answers teaches models to approximate the field, yet leaves single-path geometry out of reach.

papers.title: Search From the Start: Search-Native Pretraining for Language Models
papers.brief: 研究提出搜索原生预训练：在普通文本语料中大规模插入搜索查询，并用本地索引检索响应，训练模型生成搜索调用、结合检索证据完成语言建模。
papers.tldr: 将搜索调用与检索证据融入预训练，让更小模型获得更强知识任务能力。
papers.what_it_is: 研究提出搜索原生预训练：在普通文本语料中大规模插入搜索查询，并用本地索引检索响应，训练模型生成搜索调用、结合检索证据完成语言建模。
key_points: 覆盖Wikipedia、DCLM-Edu及3.6亿至33亿参数
14亿QueryLM在知识任务上持平或胜过等算力33亿基线
双方经监督微调后，搜索预训练模型仍保有优势
papers.why_notable: 结果表明，搜索能力的训练阶段会影响最终表现，所测试的后训练流程无法完全补齐差距，也展示了小模型提升知识任务表现的路径。
papers.abstract: Modern language models (LMs) are increasingly deployed with access to search tools at inference. Yet pretraining remains predominantly focused on predicting static text, with search capabilities typically introduced during post-training. We propose Search-Native Pretraining as a practical route to teach search capability during pretraining from ordinary text corpora. Specifically, we augment pretraining corpus at scale with web-search queries and retrieve web response using a local index. Training on this augmented corpus teaches models to generate search calls and incorporate retrieved evidence during language modeling. Across Wikipedia and DCLM-Edu corpora and 360M to 3.3B parameter scales, search-pretrained models ("QueryLM") show improved performance on knowledge-intensive tasks and higher steerability toward the retrieved evidence. Crucially, their advantage persists after supervised fine-tuning of both search-pretrained and conventionally pretrained models, indicating that the tested post-training procedures do not fully recover the capabilities developed during pretraining. Throughout our experiments, we find that a 1.4B QueryLM consistently beats or matches the performance of a FLOP-matched 3.3B baseline model across all knowledge intensive tasks. These results establish search-pretraining as a practical way to develop foundational search capabilities during pretraining. We release the training artifacts, including model checkpoints and data.

papers.title: Exploited Before It Was Fixed? Vulnerability Timelines from Open, Machine-Readable Evidence
papers.brief: 研究在Vulnerability-Lookup中实现证据模型，选取漏洞生命周期各事件的最早证据，保留日期精度与来源，并清理目录导入和错误分类造成的测量偏差。
papers.tldr: 通过可追溯公开证据重建漏洞时间线，揭示利用与修复间隔的测量偏差。
papers.what_it_is: 研究在Vulnerability-Lookup中实现证据模型，选取漏洞生命周期各事件的最早证据，保留日期精度与来源，并清理目录导入和错误分类造成的测量偏差。
key_points: 3758个有利用证据的漏洞中，仅15.7%有补丁证据
清理后59个漏洞的修复证据晚于利用证据，中位间隔7.6天
某采集器误把利用代码发布当作实际利用，占初始利用日期40%
papers.why_notable: 将漏洞利用到修复的间隔转化为可追溯测量，同时揭示目录时间戳与证据缺失如何扭曲结果，为安全响应评估提供依据。
papers.abstract: -05-X-03), Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalogs, and exploitation sightings. We introduce an evidence model implemented in Vulnerability-Lookup that selects the earliest evidence for each lifecycle event, distinguishes vulnerability-specific records, preserves date precision, and ensures traceability to original sources. Among 3,758 vulnerability identifiers with exploitation evidence, 98% have disclosure dates, while only 15.7% have patch evidence. Vendor-side dates required by VTEM are entirely absent. Most exploitation dates originate from catalog listings, including 1,041 entries associated with bulk catalog imports. After excluding these entries and ambiguous same-day observations, 59 vulnerabilities exhibit patch evidence following exploitation evidence, with a median interval of 7.6 days, predominantly between catalog listings and distributor fixes. Evidence traceability also exposes systematic measurement errors: one collector incorrectly classified exploit publications as active exploitation, accounting for 40% of initial exploitation dates, while another catalog assigned vulnerability publication timestamps to 11% of its listings. Our findings demonstrate that exploitation-to-patch intervals are computationally measurable, but their reliability depends on the availability, precision, and provenance of published evidence. We identify the additional disclosure, exploitation observation, and patch availability timestamps needed to improve vulnerability lifecycle measurements.

papers.title: Taking Apart and Putting Together: Tracking Objects Through Physical Transformations
papers.brief: 提出物体拆装追踪任务及免训练框架TIPO，从掩码生成拆分与合并候选，以重叠评分筛选，再由多模态大模型验证变化并赋予语义标签，持续更新实体关系图。
papers.tldr: 免训练框架持续识别物体拆装，在视频追踪中更新实体身份与关系图。
papers.what_it_is: 提出物体拆装追踪任务及免训练框架TIPO，从掩码生成拆分与合并候选，以重叠评分筛选，再由多模态大模型验证变化并赋予语义标签，持续更新实体关系图。
key_points: TIPO用内外重叠与掩码解码器先验评估拆分、合并候选
VISTA含50段视频、超2.6万帧及256次拆装事件
追踪与状态图准确率达最优，比既有方法快6至15倍
papers.why_notable: 将视频追踪从外观连续性推进到实体身份与关系变化，并同时覆盖组装和拆解；配套状态图标注为评测物理变化理解提供基准。
papers.abstract: We introduce Transformation Tracking and Understanding (TTU), extending video object tracking to environments where objects undergo physical assemblies and disassemblies. TTU requires continuously tracking objects through transformations, identifying new entities, maintaining a state graph of their relationships, and assigning semantic labels to transformations. While foundation models (e.g., SAM 2/3) maintain tracklets through appearance changes, they cannot update semantic identities as objects physically evolve. Prior work addresses only disassemblies, relying on expensive searches triggered only when tracking fails. We propose Tracking Instances via Proposals and Overlaps (TIPO), a training-free framework that continuously infers transformations via a generate-evaluate-judge pipeline. TIPO generates split and merge proposals from disjoint mask components, scores them against mask-decoder priors using inner and external overlap, and queries an MLLM on the top proposal for visual verification and semantic labeling. To benchmark TTU, we curate Video Instances, States, and Transformation Annotations (VISTA), a dataset including state graphs with 124 assembly and 132 disassembly events across 50 sequences and over 26,000 frames. TIPO achieves state-of-the-art tracking and state-graph accuracy on VISTA, while operating $6\times$ to $15\times$ faster than prior methods. Project page: https://davidegardenal.github.io/tipo-tracking

papers.title: Prune to Expand: Training Prompt Enhancers with Less to Imitate
papers.brief: 提出纯文本方法P2E，在逐样本删除上限内剪除密集描述的冗余句子，保留明确用户要求与有效视觉结构，再用精简后的描述监督训练提示增强模型。
papers.tldr: 通过删减密集描述中的冗余监督，让提示增强模型更好保留用户意图并提升图像质量。
papers.what_it_is: 提出纯文本方法P2E，在逐样本删除上限内剪除密集描述的冗余句子，保留明确用户要求与有效视觉结构，再用精简后的描述监督训练提示增强模型。
key_points: 生成收益高低不同的描述对，训练出的PE模型表现相近
P2E按样本限制删句数量，保留用户要求与视觉结构
相同训练配置下，跨图像类别与生成器优于密集描述SFT
papers.why_notable: 揭示图像生成收益并不等于监督价值，以低复杂度的数据剪枝减少无关细节模仿，同时改善人类偏好对齐与视觉质量。
papers.abstract: Prompt enhancement (PE) refines concise user prompts into detailed descriptions to improve the compositional aesthetics of generated images while preserving user intent. A common practice constructs supervised fine-tuning (SFT) pairs by deriving short, user-like prompts from dense captions, implicitly assuming that captions that improve image generation also provide effective supervision. In this paper, however, we uncover a counterintuitive finding: PE models trained on caption pairs with substantial generation gains perform comparably to those trained on pairs with only marginal gains. We argue that dense captions can impose redundant supervision by requiring PE models to reproduce image-specific details weakly related to user intent. Motivated by this discrepancy, we introduce Prune to Expand (P2E), a simple text-only method that refines dense-caption supervision by selectively removing redundant sentences under a per-example deletion bound while preserving explicit user requirements and informative visual structure. Extensive experiments under identical training configurations demonstrate that P2E improves alignment with human preferences and visual quality over conventional dense-caption SFT across diverse image categories and visual generators.

papers.title: Explicit Style Extraction for Personalized Long-Form Text Generation
papers.brief: 提出文风分类体系StylePrism与推理时方法SP-Refine：先从用户样本提取习惯、证据及禁忌，再结合样本起草，按自评文风分数修订两轮。
papers.tldr: 通过显式提取用户文风并两轮修订，提升个性化长文本生成质量。
papers.what_it_is: 提出文风分类体系StylePrism与推理时方法SP-Refine：先从用户样本提取习惯、证据及禁忌，再结合样本起草，按自评文风分数修订两轮。
key_points: StylePrism覆盖7类、28个文风维度
3个任务、3种模型，27项比较中25项胜出
较检索增强基线平均提升10.2%，最高35.8%
papers.why_notable: 将隐式模仿转为可检查的文风画像，为个性化写作提供明确修订依据；消融表明画像应辅助修订，而非替代用户样本。
papers.abstract: Personalized long-form generation asks a language model to write new text the way a specific user would. The standard recipe, retrieval-augmented generation, places a few of the user's past texts in the prompt but leaves the model to decide what to take from them. We introduce StylePrism, a taxonomy of 28 stylistic aspects in seven categories, and SP-Refine, an inference-time method that makes style extraction an explicit step: the model first fills StylePrism with the user's patterns, quoted evidence, and habits to avoid, then drafts from the user's samples and revises the draft twice against this profile, guided by its own style scores. On the three long-form tasks of LongLaMP with three LLMs, SP-Refine outperforms LongLaMP's retrieval-augmented baseline in 25 of 27 ROUGE and METEOR comparisons, by 10.2% on average and by up to 35.8%. Annotating users' own texts with the extracted profiles shows that StylePrism captures concrete, checkable habits, from the order of rhetorical moves to a reviewer's sign-off. Ablations show that the profile helps as revision guidance, not as a replacement for the samples: writing from the profile alone is worse in all 27 comparisons, while a single implicit-inference call is a cheaper alternative that comes close. Oracle variants that let the reviser see the reference, together with reference-free controls, show that larger refinement gains require information unavailable at inference time.

papers.title: Motion-Aware Reward Modeling for Instruction-Guided Video Editing
papers.brief: 研究发现视频编辑奖励会偏爱运动被削弱的结果，并被优化过程利用。作者引入RGB帧差分支，结合运动抑制、伪造运动负样本的偏好训练及蒸馏锚点。
papers.tldr: 通过显式帧间动态与负样本偏好训练，纠正视频编辑奖励模型的运动坍塌
papers.what_it_is: 研究发现视频编辑奖励会偏爱运动被削弱的结果，并被优化过程利用。作者引入RGB帧差分支，结合运动抑制、伪造运动负样本的偏好训练及蒸馏锚点。
key_points: VE-Bench上，原复合奖励97%偏选运动抑制结果
RGB帧差分支结合两类运动负样本偏好训练
抑制候选选择率降至0%，人评相关系数0.57
papers.why_notable: 揭示了高奖励可能掩盖运动退化的评价漏洞，并在两条编辑流水线上验证运动保持，为视频编辑奖励设计提供直接依据。
papers.abstract: Reward models for instruction-guided video editing can favor temporal consistency at the expense of motion. We study this failure, termed \emph{motion collapse}, using controlled motion-suppression variants of real edits. On VE-Bench, the evaluated composite reward prefers a motion-suppressed candidate in $97\%$ of cases. Learned video rewards and a VLM judge also struggle with mild suppression, while latent optimization and reward-guided fine-tuning exploit this weakness to increase reward as motion declines. A linear probe of our base reward backbone performs near chance on mild suppression, motivating an explicit inter-frame dynamics input. We propose a motion-aware reward model that combines an RGB frame-difference stream with preference training against motion-suppressed and fabricated-motion negatives. A distillation anchor preserves alignment with human quality judgments. On the VE-Bench motion ladder, our model reduces the rate of selecting motion-suppressed candidates to $0\%$ while achieving a Spearman correlation of $0.57$ with human quality ratings. It also detects unseen suppression variants and preserves motion during reward-guided fine-tuning on two editing pipelines. These results support explicitly modeling motion in rewards for video editing.

papers.title: Which Dwarf Is This? Doppeldwarf-306 and Near-Identical Instance Retrieval
papers.brief: 研究构建包含近似青铜雕像的实例检索基准，以冻结视觉特征进行免训练检索，并评估位置先验、局部特征匹配及未知实例拒识策略。
papers.tldr: 新雕像检索基准揭示近似实例识别难点，位置加权显著提升识别率。
papers.what_it_is: 研究构建包含近似青铜雕像的实例检索基准，以冻结视觉特征进行免训练检索，并评估位置先验、局部特征匹配及未知实例拒识策略。
key_points: Doppeldwarf-306含306座雕像、1691张照片
冻结DINOv2留一检索首位准确率达93.1%
模拟用户距雕像25米，位置加权准确率达98.7%
papers.why_notable: 为地标之外的细粒度实例检索提供新测试场景，并揭示随机候选抽样会高估位置筛选收益，对手机导览系统设计有直接参考价值。
papers.abstract: Most established instance-retrieval benchmarks emphasise landmarks; small sculptures from visually similar series offer a complementary challenge. We introduce Doppeldwarf-306: 1,691 openly licensed photographs of 306 bronze dwarf statues in Wrocław, Poland, many made in themed series that share one style, with the photographer of each image recorded. With no training, nearest-neighbour search over frozen DINOv2 features names the right statue first for 93.1% of leave-one-out queries, and the best of thirteen backbones from seven pretraining paradigms reaches 94.7%. Accuracy falls slowly as candidates are added: for DINOv2, by about 0.8 points each time their number doubles. A natural design for a phone guide compares a photograph only with statues near the user. In simulation this helps, but less than an equal number of randomly chosen statues does, so random subsampling overstates its value; a permutation test ties the penalty to the real layout (p = 0.005). Used as a weight instead of a filter, location raises DINOv2 from 93.4% to 98.7% for a simulated user 25 m from the statue. With the query's photographer withheld, learned local-feature matching raises DINOv2 accuracy from 81.8% to 85.5% and also improves DINOv3. Comparing the two best candidates cuts DINOv2's false acceptance of unknown statues from 38.3% to 19.6% at 90% known acceptance.

papers.title: Seeing Is Not Acting: WARD Diagnoses the Evidence-to-State-to-Action Gap in Longitudinal Clinical Agents
papers.brief: 提出纵向临床智能体评测基准WARD，以累积证据下的检查点评测和工具交互式管理两条轨道，拆解证据识别、患者状态更新与行动选择的中间失误。
papers.tldr: WARD揭示临床智能体虽能识别证据，却难以持续更新患者状态并采取正确行动。
papers.what_it_is: 提出纵向临床智能体评测基准WARD，以累积证据下的检查点评测和工具交互式管理两条轨道，拆解证据识别、患者状态更新与行动选择的中间失误。
key_points: 涵盖4560项任务、7类输出及40条纵向临床轨迹
12个模型的关联证据未响应率达74.47%—90.90%
交互轨道中仅11.46%的执行动作推进参考状态转移
papers.why_notable: 将评测从最终结果推进到临床决策过程，揭示识别证据不等于正确行动，为定位纵向智能体的信息遗忘与决策失误提供依据。
papers.abstract: Large language models for longitudinal clinical care must revise their assessments and actions as patient information accumulates. However, benchmarks centered on isolated responses or final task outcomes provide limited insight into intermediate failures in evidence use, state updating, and action selection. We introduce WARD, a benchmark for evaluating how clinical agents translate accumulating evidence into patient-state judgments and timely, safe actions. WARD comprises 4,560 clinical tasks across seven clinical output domains, organized into 240 checkpoints from 40 longitudinal clinical trajectories spanning 95 hospitalizations. Its Longitudinal Track evaluates these tasks under controlled cumulative evidence. Its Interactive Track evaluates end-to-end, tool-mediated clinical management across 271 verifiable evidence items and 141 reference transitions. Across 12 models with scorable checkpoint outputs, evidence recognition consistently outpaces downstream state and action decisions, with linked-evidence nonresponse reaching 74.47--90.90\%. Models also struggle to retain and update information over time, while in the Interactive Track only 11.46\% of executed actions advance a reference transition. These results reveal a persistent evidence-to-state-to-action gap and highlight the need for process-level evaluation of longitudinal clinical agents.Code and data: https://github.com/Dingsuper-creator/WARD.

papers.title: Edit-Induced Dependency Mismatch: Propagation Omissions, Recovery, and Evaluation Blind Spots in Coding Agents
papers.brief: 研究审计多个代码基准上的智能体执行轨迹，追踪修改后遗漏的下游适配义务。通过执行检查、局部重放与依赖复审提示，验证缺陷及其修复路径。
papers.tldr: 编码智能体修改代码后可能沿用过时依赖判断，遗漏下游同步且逃过评测。
papers.what_it_is: 研究审计多个代码基准上的智能体执行轨迹，追踪修改后遗漏的下游适配义务。通过执行检查、局部重放与依赖复审提示，验证缺陷及其修复路径。
key_points: DeepSWE全量盲审：保留的终态遗漏均获执行支持
显式依赖复审提示在测试条件下降低终态遗漏
跨基准反例：补丁通过原评测，下游仍有执行缺陷
papers.why_notable: 揭示任务通过率可能掩盖修改引发的下游缺陷，且途中恢复不等于最终无遗漏，为分别评估任务得分、终态传播与恢复提供依据。
papers.abstract: During iterative code modification, coding agents may continue to rely in subsequent reasoning on outdated dependency judgments whose text remains fixed in the context, leading to errors in subsequent reasoning and leaving consumer defects undetected by the original task evaluations, thereby exposing blind spots in the tested benchmarks. We study actual agent execution trajectories collected on benchmark tasks: deepseek-v4-flash runs on DeepSWE and SWE-bench Verified, supplemented by Qwen3.8-Flash cases on FeatureBench. Focusing on edit-induced consumer obligations, a full-corpus blinded human audit of the DeepSWE runs identifies terminal mismatches, including diagnoses whose task scope remains disputed. Following supplementary execution checks, all retained DeepSWE terminal events have execution support. The audit also shows that recovery within a trajectory can coexist with terminal omissions in the same run. The process analysis links the presentation of relevant consumer code to explicit dependency judgments and subsequent synchronization actions recorded in the trajectories. An explicit dependency-review prompt reduces terminal omissions under the tested conditions, supporting re-derivation of consumer obligations after edits. Local replays of selected DeepSWE cases show that synchronizing the diagnosed consumers restores the target behavior while the listed controls continue to pass. Cross-benchmark execution counterexamples show that the original task evaluations do not fully detect edit-induced dependency mismatches: patches pass those evaluations, yet additional execution checks confirm unintended defects along existing consumer paths. These findings support measuring task scores, terminal propagation states, and recovery separately.

papers.title: IteraSong: LLM-Guided Iterative Symbolic Music Creation in a Web DAW
papers.brief: IteraSong是一款交互式网页音乐工作站，支持从流行音乐草稿出发反复试听与修改。大模型通过MCP工具，将自然语言请求映射为分层音乐编辑操作。
papers.tldr: 将大模型接入网页音乐工作站，让用户用自然语言持续编辑多轨乐曲。
papers.what_it_is: IteraSong是一款交互式网页音乐工作站，支持从流行音乐草稿出发反复试听与修改。大模型通过MCP工具，将自然语言请求映射为分层音乐编辑操作。
key_points: 在持久多轨项目上实现生成、试听、编辑与细化循环
MCP工具覆盖全局、音轨、段落及小节／音符层级
支持确定性与生成式编辑，以及实时撤销／重做
papers.why_notable: 把音乐生成从一次性输出转向可持续修改的创作流程，并以分层工具调用衔接自然语言意图与细粒度编辑。
papers.abstract: Music creation is inherently iterative, yet many symbolic generation systems still center on producing or regenerating isolated outputs. We present IteraSong, an interactive web-based Digital Audio Workstation (DAW) for LLM-guided iterative symbolic music creation. Unlike one-shot generation systems, IteraSong supports a generate-audition-edit-refine loop over a persistent multi-track project. Users initialize a fully labeled pop draft, then progressively refine it through natural-language instructions. The LLM maps requests to a hierarchical action space of editing primitives exposed via Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools, spanning global, track, section, and bar/note scopes. The demo enables attendees to edit multi-track compositions in natural language, apply deterministic and generative edits, and undo/redo changes in real time.

papers.title: Complementary Geometry in Gaussian Splatting
papers.brief: REVEAL将源视角深度重投影到目标视角，以鲁棒多视角共识生成候选深度，再用学习式选择机制判断是否替换原预测，全程保持原高斯表示不变。
papers.tldr: 利用跨视角深度误差的互补性，无需修改高斯表示即可提升新视角几何精度。
papers.what_it_is: REVEAL将源视角深度重投影到目标视角，以鲁棒多视角共识生成候选深度，再用学习式选择机制判断是否替换原预测，全程保持原高斯表示不变。
key_points: 以鲁棒多视角共识融合重投影深度
学习式选择依据预期深度误差下降决定替换
推出同步RGB-D基准RIG，并测试6种骨干、3个基准
papers.why_notable: 将几何改进与高斯表示优化解耦，跨多种骨干持续提升深度精度且保持相近渲染质量；新基准也支持静态与动态重建评测。
papers.abstract: Gaussian Splatting has achieved high visual quality in novel view synthesis, but the accuracy of its rendered geometry remains a challenge. In particular, the rendered depth is computed as an opacity-weighted average along each ray, which may not correspond to the actual scene surface. In this paper, we observe that depth predictions from different views of the same frozen Gaussian representation exhibit complementary errors, allowing us to improve novel-view geometry using information from other views without modifying the original representation. Based on this observation, we propose REVEAL, a general framework that selectively refines novel-view depth using complementary geometric information. Specifically, we first reproject depth predictions from source views to the target view and combine them using robust multi-view consensus. We then introduce a learned selection mechanism to determine whether the candidate depth is more accurate than the original prediction, based on the expected reduction in depth error. In addition, we introduce RIG, a real-world benchmark captured with synchronized RGB-D cameras, which provides ground-truth depth for evaluating both static and dynamic reconstruction models. Experiments on 6 Gaussian Splatting backbones across 3 benchmarks show that REVEAL consistently improves depth accuracy while maintaining comparable rendering quality.

papers.title: Why Adaptive Optimizers Struggle with Large Convolution Kernels
papers.brief: 研究将大卷积核训练困难归因于Adam等优化器的逐权重归一化。提出DCT-Rep，在离散余弦系数上训练以隔离均值，训练后转换回卷积权重。
papers.tldr: 研究揭示自适应优化器放大大卷积核均值更新，并用余弦域训练缓解不稳定。
papers.what_it_is: 研究将大卷积核训练困难归因于Adam等优化器的逐权重归一化。提出DCT-Rep，在离散余弦系数上训练以隔离均值，训练后转换回卷积权重。
key_points: 均值更新放大k倍，最大学习率可降至1/k²
DCT-Rep不增参数与推理成本，训练开销可忽略
ConvNeXt-T准确率增0.79%，COCO增1.4 AP
papers.why_notable: 把大核训练瓶颈定位到优化器的更新几何，并给出低成本修正；收益覆盖分类、检测、分割与复原，且随核尺寸增大。
papers.abstract: Large convolution kernels enlarge the receptive fields of ConvNets at a modest computational cost, but they are notoriously difficult to train. Existing large-kernel networks therefore rely on costly training techniques, such as parallel small-kernel branches with batch normalization. In this paper, we trace this difficulty to adaptive optimizers such as Adam, which normalize the update of every weight separately. Since input features rarely average to zero, all weights of a kernel share a common gradient, and these optimizers move the mean of a $k\times k$ kernel $k$ times as far as a single parameter. We find this mean amplification in widely used ConvNets and vision transformers, and show that it can force the maximal learning rate to fall as $1/k^2$. We further prove that the basis of the discrete cosine transform (DCT) isolates the mean and is the only orthonormal basis that diagonalizes every stationary gradient statistic with mirrored boundaries. We therefore train large kernels through their DCT coefficients and convert them back after training. The resulting method, DCT-Rep, requires only a few lines of code and adds no parameters, no inference cost and negligible training overhead. Extensive experiments on image classification, object detection, semantic segmentation and image restoration show that DCT-Rep consistently improves large-kernel ConvNets and vision transformers, by $+0.79\%$ top-1 accuracy for a large-kernel ConvNeXt-T and $+0.43\%$ for ViT-S/16 on ImageNet-1K, $+1.4$ box AP on COCO, $+1.2$ mIoU on ADE20K and up to $+0.4$ dB on image deblurring, where the gain grows with the kernel size.

papers.title: Ego-HMB: Human Motion Bridging from Egocentric Images via A Motion Bridge Diffusion Model
papers.brief: 提出统一扩散框架，从两张第一人称图像补全三维人体运动。先以逐步扩展时间跨度的课程预训练学习端点姿态，再用端点与物理感知的运动桥扩散生成连续动作。
papers.tldr: 用两张第一人称端点图像生成连贯三维人体动作，兼顾端点准确性与时序连续性。
papers.what_it_is: 提出统一扩散框架，从两张第一人称图像补全三维人体运动。先以逐步扩展时间跨度的课程预训练学习端点姿态，再用端点与物理感知的运动桥扩散生成连续动作。
key_points: Egocentric-to-Canonical预训练逐步扩大时间跨度
Motion Bridge Diffusion从相邻姿态扩散
端点精度与动作质量均优于单阶段及两阶段基线
papers.why_notable: 将动作补全的输入从结构化三维姿态推进到可穿戴设备的原始图像，为虚拟现实、增强现实及机器人场景提供更直接的运动重建路径。
papers.abstract: We introduce Egocentric Human Motion Bridging, a task that generates a coherent 3D human motion sequence from two endpoint egocentric images. Unlike conventional motion in-betweening, which requires structured 3D endpoint poses, this setting uses raw first-person observations available from wearable devices in VR/AR and robotics. It presents challenges due to viewpoint variations, partial body visibility, and temporal ambiguity under cross-modal endpoint constraints. To address these challenges, we propose Ego-HMB, a unified diffusion-based framework that learns endpoint pose estimation and temporally consistent motion infilling within a single model through two training stages. First, Egocentric-to-Canonical Pretraining uses a hierarchical curriculum with progressively increasing temporal spans to strengthen endpoint pose priors. Second, Motion Bridge Diffusion Training incorporates endpoint and physics awareness, diffusing from neighboring poses to promote temporal continuity while preserving global endpoint constraints. Extensive experiments compare our approach with one-stage methods that directly generate motion from two egocentric images and two-stage pipelines that combine endpoint pose estimation with motion interpolation. Ego-HMB consistently outperforms these baselines in endpoint accuracy and motion generation quality. Code is available at https://github.com/gaogehan/Ego-HMB.

papers.title: PartPO: Part-Level Policy Optimization for Shape-to-Program Generation
papers.brief: PartPO利用形状程序中语义部件与代码块的对应关系，将奖励分配到部件、类别和整段程序，并借助开放词汇分割自动获取部件监督。
papers.tldr: 通过部件级奖励优化三维点云到程序的生成，提升形状重建与跨数据集泛化。
papers.what_it_is: PartPO利用形状程序中语义部件与代码块的对应关系，将奖励分配到部件、类别和整段程序，并借助开放词汇分割自动获取部件监督。
key_points: 部件奖励对应代码块，类别奖励仅作用于对象名称
开放词汇分割利用模型自身输出调优提示，无需人工标注
基于MeshCoder优化，在ShapeNetCore、ABO提升并泛化至HSSD
papers.why_notable: 将长程序的信用分配细化到语义部件，同时免去人工部件标注，为执行反馈驱动的结构化三维生成提供更有效的优化路径。
papers.abstract: We present PartPO, a reinforcement learning method for generating structured shape programs from 3D point clouds. Existing shape-to-program models are trained with supervised learning on procedurally generated data and generalize poorly to more diverse shapes, while reinforcement learning from execution feedback assigns a single scalar reward to a long program that builds many parts, making credit assignment difficult. PartPO instead builds on a core property of the task: shape programs are self-describing, with each semantically named part produced by its own code block. It segments each generated program by its parts and applies part-level rewards only to the code of the corresponding part, a category reward only to the object name, and a shape-level reward to the whole program. The required part supervision is obtained without manual annotation, by grounding part names on target meshes with an open-vocabulary segmentation model prompt-tuned on the model's own outputs. Applied to MeshCoder, PartPO improves reconstruction accuracy and execution success on ShapeNetCore and ABO over the base model, rejection-sampling fine-tuning and trajectory-level RL, and generalizes to the unseen HSSD dataset. Code will be released at https://github.com/HannuoZ/PartPO.

papers.title: DriveTTO: Understanding Search and Selection in Test-Time Trajectory Optimization for End-to-End Driving
papers.brief: DriveTTO围绕原生轨迹提案逐步缩小搜索邻域，使用冻结评分器评价实际到达终点的完整路径。它融合规划提案与控制扰动分支，仅在双评分器均预测增益时接受更新。
papers.tldr: 无需训练的测试时轨迹优化，通过双分支搜索与评分筛选改善端到端驾驶规划。
papers.what_it_is: DriveTTO围绕原生轨迹提案逐步缩小搜索邻域，使用冻结评分器评价实际到达终点的完整路径。它融合规划提案与控制扰动分支，仅在双评分器均预测增益时接受更新。
key_points: 双分支分别搜索规划提案与控制扰动，按时间对齐融合位姿
Navtest原生零分案例中，平均51.35%恢复非零PDMS
单评分器DriveTTO-S在两项基准上改善全部6个规划器
papers.why_notable: 将改进重点从训练转向推理时搜索与筛选，提供可复用的规划增强机制；计入新增失败后，零分率仍从1.63%降至1.13%。
papers.abstract: In difficult driving scenes, a learned scorer can select a poor trajectory from a fixed pool even when a better candidate is available. Nearby vehicles and road boundaries can also leave only a narrow range of high-scoring maneuvers. These constraints vary with the scene and are difficult to cover exhaustively during training. We introduce DriveTTO, a training-free method that searches around native proposals and checks each proposed refinement against a retained trajectory. A frozen scorer evaluates completed paths at the endpoints they actually reach, guiding resampling in progressively smaller neighborhoods. From a shared reference, one branch draws on planner proposals and another perturbs vehicle controls. DriveTTO blends their poses at matching times and accepts a branch or fusion update only when both frozen scorers predict a gain. On Navtest, DriveTTO recovers nonzero predictive driver model scores (PDMS) in 51.35% of native zero-score cases on average. Accounting for new failures, the zero-score rate falls from 1.63% to 1.13%. Benchmark-specific configurations achieve 95.54 PDMS and 92.30 extended PDMS (EPDMS) on Navtest, 57.10 EPDMS on Navhard, and 40.1 HD-Score on HUGSIM under observed commands. With a single frozen scorer, DriveTTO-S improves all six evaluated planners on both Navtest and Navhard.
